items.title: 20.2 Tibbi imaging mein ultrasound ka tashkheesi istemal (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 20.2, diagnostic use of ultrasound (PDF 158-159); d = vt/2 is ours (Roman Urdu only).

blocks.text: Ultrasound medical imaging ka aam tareeqa hai jis se doctors jism ke andar ke hisse usi waqt (real time) dekh sakte hain. Ultrasound machine ka labelled diagram Fig. 20.2 mein hai. Machine transducer naam ke aale se bohat zyada frequency ki awaz ki waves, aam taur par 1 MHz se 15 MHz, jism mein bhejti hai. Yeh waves jism mein chalti hain aur mukhtalif tissues ki sarhadon (boundaries) se takra kar palatti hain. In wapas aane wali awazon (echoes) ko jama kar ke tasveer banai jati hai. Bara faida yeh hai ke ultrasound ionizing radiation istemal nahi karta, is liye yeh mehfooz, non-invasive aur baar baar kiya ja sakne wala tareeqa hai.

Yeh kuch physics ke usoolon par chalta hai. Pehle piezoelectric transducer ultrasound ke pulses (chhote chhote jhatke) bhejta hai, jo har tissue mein alag speed se chalte hain. Jab wave do aise tissues ki sarhad par pohanchti hai jin ki acoustic impedance (awaz ke guzarne mein rukawat, jo tissue ki density aur us mein awaz ki speed se tay hoti hai) alag ho, to wave ka kuch hissa palat aata hai. Phir transducer receive mode mein chala jata hai aur direct piezoelectric effect se in reflected waves ko pakarta hai. Echoes bijli ke signals mein badal kar machine mein process hote hain. Aakhir mein computer har echo ke wapas aane ka waqt (time delay) aur us ki taqat (intensity) se tasveer banata hai. Jahan reflection zyada taqatwar ho woh hissa tasveer mein zyada roshan dikhta hai.

blocks.caption: Figure 20.2: ultrasound machine (kitab ki Figure 20.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Probe skin par rakh kar ultrasound pulses andar bhejta hai (safaid lehrein); tissues ki sarhadon se echo wapas probe tak aati hai. Pulse sarhad tak ja kar wapas aata hai, is liye echo ke aane ka waqt t ho to sarhad ki gehrai d = vt/2 hai, jahan naram tissue mein awaz ki speed v taqreeban 1540 m s⁻¹ hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Ultrasound probe ke crystals chawal ke daane se bhi chhote hote hain, phir bhi awaz ki waves bhej bhi sakte hain aur pakar bhi sakte hain.
Tasveer ke mayaar (image quality) par asar dalne wali cheezein

items: Acoustic impedance ka farq: do tissues (maslan naram tissue aur haddi) ki impedance mein jitna zyada farq, echo utni taqatwar aur sarhad tasveer mein utni saaf.

Ultrasound ki frequency: zyada frequency se resolution (barik cheezein alag dikhna) behtar lekin waves kam gehrai tak jati hain; kam frequency zyada gehrai tak jati hai lekin tasveer kam saaf hoti hai.
Gel ka istemal: transducer aur skin ke darmiyan khaas gel lagaya jata hai taa ke hawa ke khali hisse (air gaps) khatam hon aur awaz ki waves achhi tarah andar jayein.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Ultrasound Doppler effect se, yani awaz ki frequency mein tabdeeli pakar kar, khoon ke behne ki speed bhi naap sakta hai.

Ultrasound bohat se medical shobon mein pehchan ke liye istemal hota hai. Obstetrics (zachgi ka shoba) mein bachche ki growth, hamal ki umar (gestational age) ka andaza aur hamal mein kharabiyon ki pehchan. Pet (abdomen) mein jigar (liver), gurde (kidneys), pitta (gallbladder), pancreas aur masana (bladder) ki jaanch. Cardiology mein echo cardiography se doctors dil ki banawat aur kaam usi waqt dekhte hain. Urology mein prostate, testicles aur peshab ke nizam (urinary system) ki jaanch. Musculoskeletal system (patthe aur haddiyan) mein ligament ki chot, joron ki sozish (inflammation) aur naram tissues ki doosri bimariyon ki pehchan.

blocks.prompt: Pulse bhejne ke 65 microsecond baad echo wapas aati hai. Agar tissue mein awaz ki speed 1540 m s⁻¹ ho to sarhad kitni gehri hai?

items: Ultrasound (1-15 MHz) alag acoustic impedance wale tissues ki sarhadon se palatta hai; echo ka waqt aur taqat tasveer banate hain.
Gehrai d = vt/2; taqatwar echo zyada roshan.
Image quality: impedance ka farq, frequency (resolution ya gehrai), gel.
Istemal: hamal, pet ke aza, dil (echo cardiography), urology, patthe aur jor.
